title: Mendelssohn House, Leipzig
scope: The standing late-Classical Mendelssohn House at Goldschmidtstraße 12, with its four-storey façade, hipped roof, and the associated low, dormered historic garden house.
limitations: The 1900 street image covers most of the original frontage. The precise current siding color, door and shop joinery, modest rear openings, roof vents and exact projecting dimensions are approximate.
The open garden is preserved between both models. Neighboring apartments, courtyard planting and interiors are outside the selected scope.
